procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 11 was represented by Richard Shultheis (helm).
GBR 102 was represented by Sam Jones (helm).
Ryan Seaton (coach of GER 11) was present during the hearing as an observer.
Tyfus Butowski (helm of POL 73) presented evidence during the hearing as a witness.
The international jury presented video evidence.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 7-8 knots of wind and small chop.
Shortly after having rounded mark 1, GER 11 was sailing on starboard tack overlapped half a boat length to leeward of GBR 102, also on starboard tack. GER 11's bow was in front of GBR 102.
While hoisting the gennaker, GER 11 lost speed and GBR 102's bow passed in front, rolling the other boat while remaining overlapped.
GER 11 luffed smoothly and the lateral distance between the boats decreased to half a metre. GBR 102 luffed as well.
conclusions: GBR 102 to windward kept clear of GER 11 to leeward, as required by RRS 11.
When GER 11, the right-of-way boat, changed course she gave room to GBR 102 to keep clear, as required by RRS 16.1.
decision: The protest is dismissed. No rule is broken.
